sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Sticky filter bars (WIP.3) now also keep the page heading with the action buttons and the status line at the top of the window while scrolling down, on every page and from the moment it opens. On an artist, release or other entity page that is the whole entity header (the name and the line under it with the status); elsewhere the heading and the status line under it. The section bar with the global filter sits right under them. In a window too small for all of it, the heading scrolls away and the bars still stay. MusicBrainz's own menus at the top of the page still open over the heading.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Report pages (e.g. Event annotations, ISRCs with many recordings) and the CD stub list: the status line ("Loaded … Fetching …") sat below the section bar with the global filter instead of right under the page heading. It is back under the heading.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Sticky filter bars: scrolling down a table now keeps the section bar with the global filter and the row count at the top of the window, with the column headers right under it. On a page with several sub-tables the bar of the sub-table you are in, with its own filter, stays under the section bar, and the next sub-table's bar takes its place as you scroll into it. Under a fixed site header (springsteenlyrics.com's navbar, or a MusicBrainz header made sticky by a userstyle) the bars sit below it. ⚙️ 📌 Table stickiness → "Enable Sticky Filter Bars", on by default; off brings back the old behaviour, where only the column headers stay.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase: the status line ("Loaded 1 page …") sat below the thin rule under the heading with the buttons, and on the song list the breadcrumbs ran into it. It now sits between the heading and the rule, with the breadcrumbs below.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase: the wiki's side bar (Site Navigation, Gig Pages, …) stays in view while you scroll: at the top of the window when you scroll down a year's events, and at the window's edge when you scroll the wide table sideways, with the Date column docking just right of it.

Brucebase: the side bar's collapse handle has its own setting, ⚙️ 📚 Brucebase → "Collabsable sidebar", off by default, so the side bar now shows without a handle. The MusicBrainz setting of that name no longer applies there; "Start with sidebar collapsed" still does once the handle is on.
